lastTask: Implement Byte L1e candidate-store anchor phrase genomes

projectState.summary: Byte L1d was approved and fast-forwarded to main. Byte L1e is implemented on codex/byte-l1e-anchor-genome-store: phrase candidates can store native anchor-phrase/v1 genomes while legacy flat PlayerPatternSource genomes remain valid. The shared renderPhraseCandidateGenome() adapter feeds existing scoring, diversity, B2 development, D2 audition, and D5 evolving performance paths with the old flat shape. The server independently normalizes/bounds anchor phrase genomes without changing the SQLite schema. Awaiting Claude review.
